retro:
# Retrospective: PR #12671

## What worked

- Security triage distinguished ordinary dangerous kernel reproductions from malicious instructions. No host hibernation or secret-memory experiment was attempted.
- Both fresh technical reviewers received neutral equal scope and remained independent until both finals existed. No findings was accepted.
- Sol's focused nine-case fixture and Opus's guarded direct base/head cases answered the material question without a desktop reservation.
- Actual production head code ran against synthetic files, with baseline path adaptation explicitly disclosed. No spurious baseline comparison using ineffective env overrides.
- Raw audit caught overclaimed stock-test compliance before drafting. The invalid scope was preserved and withdrawn rather than silently relabeled.

## Deviations and remediation

Coordinator initial policy reads and Opus combined policy chunks exceeded the 60-line read bound. Sol emitted a large public source blob, creating automatic Pi overflow outside assignment storage. Preserve all native history. Read bounded source sections and no more than 60 aggregate policy lines per tool response; complete every tail before execution.

Opus stock test/mutation children 033-037 ran under review.py, but TMPDIR containment did not individually assert upstream writes, semantic checks were deferred, and internal statuses/input files were discarded by stock cleanup. Those totals are excluded, not needed. Only Opus direct children 004-031 and syntax children 001-003, plus Sol's independently valid nine-case run, support claims. The original final.md and sealed run stay unchanged; audit-addendum.md supersedes scope.

The assignment-local PROCESS-CORRECTION.md makes the next decision explicit: choose an independently guarded focused fixture when stock tests lack target/status/retention guarantees; do not claim stock pass or mutation discrimination without an audited private adaptation. No rerun was warranted once the material public claim had valid independent evidence.

## Tools and resources

No confirmed tool defect, no Omadev issue and no desktop allocation. review.py seals verified, but seals alone were not treated as producer correctness. The diagnostic children completed synchronously. No live runtime remains, no host pattern killing was used. Keep inert source and evidence files. Technical reviewer panes remain intact for outer-managed reset after publication; coordinator never resets itself.

## Useful future intake improvement

Read directly linked existing PRs for duplicate changed blobs where issue discussion already identifies another proposed fix. Treat duplicate work as neutral consolidation context, never as evidence of intent. This review makes no recommendation to change author policy.
